what: Tier-4 success would emit the wrong REVISE_PATCH_PATH
scenario_or_breakage: A fallback winner writes <tool>-fallback-output.txt, but finalize still derives <tool>-output.txt from winner, so the success KV points at the earlier unified-diff artifact or a missing file
suggested_fix: Track the actual winning output path in attempt_tier, or conditionally use <tool>-fallback-output.txt when winner_is_fallback is true
